validation.result: plan A (motor up, shaft below, millstone) reported two warnings: motor facing mismatch and millstone bottom free; plan B added a side cogwheel and a chute below the millstone and reported the cogwheel rejection plus the chute-into-millstone warning
validation.note: the model also misread the cogwheel axis rejection; the check surface itself worked

full_run.reason: model reported every shaft at 0 RPM with the warning that its faces do not meet a powered output; it proposed a gravity-fed skeleton without power and stopped
full_run.note: the warning text reached the model unchanged, so the remaining gap is the model acting on it, not missing feedback

verdict: pre-build warnings work and are visible to the model, but no autonomous two-stage line was produced; the failure is now the model's placement decisions rather than missing tool feedback
